## ✨ Highlights

The rest of the 2026-11-05 security review: its hardening items, and,
found while treating them, a way around v2026.11.07's identity rule.

- 🔐 **A node's identity and its fleet's reset take a console
  certificate**: a certificate the node issued through its API - one an
  admin had it make - no longer reaches them. Only a rescue
  certificate, or the fleet's recovery kit (`-kit`), does.
- 🛡️ **Hardening across the nodes, the Controller and janusctl**: the
  connectivity test keeps away from the node's own services, an open
  pairing window renews its code every hour, a removed standby drops its
  copy, and a few more.

## ⚠️ Upgrade notes

- **An older node's first-boot admin credential** no longer replaces
  its identity (`system state export -identity`) nor resets its fleet
  (`access trust-reset`): use the recovery kit (`-kit KIT`) or a rescue
  volume ([recovery](https://janus.sw-servers.net/docs/guide/recovery.md#neither)).
- **Single sign-on trusted as is** (the provider's second factor, no
  ACR nor AMR asked): an account you linked - with a password or a
  second factor of its own here - is asked its own factor again;
  accounts the provider made are unchanged
  ([the second factor](https://janus.sw-servers.net/docs/guide/sso.md#the-second-factor)).
- **A pairing window's code changes every hour** while it waits: read
  the console again if janusctl or the Controller says the certificate
  isn't the one the code names.

## 🔒 Security

- **Janus itself** (nodes), its own code:
  - 🟡 medium [JANUS-2026-033](https://github.com/swenske/Janus/blob/v2026.11.08/security/fixes/JANUS-2026-033.json) - An admin could still reach a node's identity through a certificate the node issued itself. Any admin can have a node issue a certificate of its own CA (`GenerateClientConfiguration`, the Controller's node page, `LocalCARotate`); with one, a fleet admin's 12-hour certificate reached the identity JANUS-2026-031 kept for the node's own CA, and passed `TrustReset`. Every node trusting a fleet: update it.

## 🔌 The node API

- `StateExport`/`StateExportGrant` with `include_identity`, and
  `AccessService.TrustReset`: a certificate of the node's own CA counts
  only when it was issued at the console (a rescue certificate, which
  carries OID 2.999.1.2), or the fleet's root's own.
- `GenerateClientConfiguration` refuses names starting with `rescue:` or
  `kit:`.

## 🧰 Nodes

- **A console certificate for the identity and the fleet's reset**
  ([JANUS-2026-033](https://github.com/swenske/Janus/blob/v2026.11.08/security/fixes/JANUS-2026-033.json)).
  Certificates issued through the API keep every other use
  ([trust](https://janus.sw-servers.net/docs/internals/trust.md#what-a-node-accepts)).
- **The connectivity test keeps to the network**: the node itself and
  link-local addresses (`169.254.169.254`) are for whoever may also
  change its HAProxy configuration
  ([connectivity test](https://janus.sw-servers.net/docs/guide/connectivity-probe.md)).
- **An open pairing window renews its certificate and code every hour**,
  so the code's fingerprint never names one certificate for long
  ([the pairing window](https://janus.sw-servers.net/docs/internals/trust.md#the-pairing-window)).
- **A malformed volume can't take the boot down**: init reads NoCloud
  and rescue volumes without risking PID 1.
- **Only the Controller's own certificate is shown as the Controller**
  in a node's clients - not one merely named after it.

## 🖥️ Controller

- **A removed standby drops its copy**: at its next pull, the standby
  the active forgot deletes its last copy - the active's data and
  master key - and pairs with no one
  ([standby](https://janus.sw-servers.net/docs/guide/controller-standby.md)).
  A standby warns about a master key beside its data, as the active does.
- **Single sign-on**: a provider trusted as is stands for the second
  factor of the accounts it made only.
- **CSP reports**: one address can't use up the minute's log lines.

## 🔧 janusctl

- **The dashboard draws no control character** - C1 controls and
  bidirectional overrides included, the traffic map's labels too.
